texts: Whenever a cliff-spire shields a cove against north winds, each lantern in that cove burns stably through winter.
Whenever a cliff-spire shelters a cove, each lantern in that cove stays lit through winter.

fields.sentence: Whenever a cliff-spire shields a cove against north winds, each lantern in that cove burns stably through winter.
parse: (: whenever_shield_burn (Implication (And (Member $e shield) (Agent $e $cs) (Member $cs cliff_spire) (Theme $e $cv) (Member $cv cove) (Against $e north_wind) (Member $l lantern) (LocatedIn $l $cv)) (And (Member (sk_burn $e $l) burn) (Patient (sk_burn $e $l) $l) (Manner (sk_burn $e $l) stably) (Through (sk_burn $e $l) winter) (During (sk_burn $e $l) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A durative extent PP "through winter" on an eventuality: During is licensed only for during/while/throughout (never a synonym head), Time carries points/named times rather than an extent, and (Measure e duration n unit) needs a stated count — so a "through <season>" span falls back to a bare preposition-named oblique with no way to record that it is an extent.
review.notes: The whenever-machinery is applied correctly with the nested "each lantern" universal folded in as a second premise range and the Skolem event a function of both bindings, the During tie to the trigger present, and the QuantifierPhrase emitted for "each" but not for "whenever"; Against and Through are preposition-named obliques using the words actually used.

fields.sentence: Whenever a cliff-spire shelters a cove, each lantern in that cove stays lit through winter.
parse: (: whenever_shelter_lit (Implication (And (Member $x cliff_spire) (Member $sh shelter) (Agent $sh $x) (Member $c cove) (Theme $sh $c) (Member $l lantern) (LocatedIn $l $c)) (And (Member (sk_lit $l) lit) (Experiencer (sk_lit $l) $l) (Still (sk_lit $l)) (Time (sk_lit $l) winter) (During (sk_lit $l) $sh) (Member $l lit))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The consequent's state witness (sk_lit $l) is a Skolem function of the lantern alone, although the universally quantified sheltering occurrence $sh also scopes over it (the conclusion During-links to $sh), so distinct sheltering occurrences collapse onto one lit-state witness per lantern instead of the per-universal Skolem term the doctrine requires.

q2_gaps: durative/spanning "through <period>" frame adverbial ("through winter") — During is licensed only for during/while/throughout nesting two reified eventualities, Measure duration needs a stated count, and Start/End need stated endpoints, so the spanning force has no carrier and is flattened into a bare Time atom
no structured time term for a season — the term list is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, so a bare "winter" symbol on Time is the only available slot
review.notes: The continuation copular "stays lit" is correctly reified state + Still + flat (Member $l lit) with no matrix event and no Result link, and the demonstrative "that cove" correctly binds the premise variable.

issues.reason: Quantifiers & scope states that each dependent existential is "a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it", and the sheltering occurrence $sh demonstrably scopes over this conclusion (it fills the During slot), so (sk_lit $l) mints one state token per lantern for arbitrarily many sheltering occurrences and then asserts that single state is During each of them — a nesting no one state can satisfy.

gaps_confirmed: durative/spanning "through <period>" has no licensed carrier: During covers only during/while/throughout nesting two reified eventualities, (Measure e duration n u) needs a stated count, and Start/End need stated endpoints
the Time term inventory (Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute) has no season term, so a bare winter constant on Time is the only available slot
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form parameterizes the state witness on both universals — (sk_lit $sh $l) in every conclusion conjunct that names it (Member, Experiencer, Still, Time, During) — leaving the premise, the flat (Member $l lit), and the rule's (STV 1.0 0.9) unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The rest is sound: whenever routed to the rule machinery with plain-variable premises, "that cove" bound to the premise variable, the continuation copular "stays lit" reified as state + Still + flat atom with no matrix event and no Result, and no companion for whenever beside the "each" one. (Time (sk_lit ...) winter) is a true, well-typed atom in genuine gap territory, so it is not a defect.
